name: Stage 15:1: Läggesta to Långaedet, etapp 15
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 15:1, Läggesta to Långaedet, etapp 15.
utilities: Läggesta station is the only strong utility node on 15:1 itself, with rail/bus access, paid parking, three toilets including accessible WC, waiting-room/kiosk context, taxi, lifts, bike parking, and locked cycle garage. Terminal-map bus context includes lines 303, 305, 306, 543, 642, 646, and 841; live-check departures.

Läggesta parking is paid rather than ordinary free trail parking: station zone 18853, currently 30 SEK/day or 340 SEK/month, with a maximum 7 consecutive days on paid outdoor/garage spaces; long-stay/gravel-area rules should be checked locally.

After leaving Läggesta, no confirmed on-connector shelter, campsite, fireplace, toilet, shop, or reliable potable trail tap was verified. Treat Långaedet/Mellan-Marviken services as nearby continuation context, not core 15:1 facilities.
Långaedet is a trail junction into stage 15, not a public-transport trailhead. Naturkartan finds no useful stops there; train-based trips should use Läggesta unless continuing through.
waterSources: No reliable potable trail water was confirmed on 15:1 before the main-route junction; carry water from Läggesta unless continuing to known Stage 15 sources.

The official water note points to a cold spring a short distance after joining Stage 15 toward Stage 14. It is roughly 160 m straight-line from the 15:1 junction and about 300 m by trail context; OSM maps drinking_water nearby, but hiker reports describe missed/dry springs in this broader area, so treat/filter and do not count it as on-connector water.
Laketorpsån is scenic stream/rest context, not a drinking-water refill; older Sörmlandsleden material explicitly warns hikers not to drink from the brook.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official distance is 6 km; Naturkartan/Äventyrligare and measured GPX are about 6.15-6.2 km, while AllTrails-style traces can show 6.6-6.8 km with about 200 m ascent. Use official distance for planning and mapped distance for geometry.

OSM relation 3806868 is the correct 15:1 connector and measures about 6.163 km. The official direction is Läggesta to Långaedet, but raw member order can behave as junction-to-Läggesta; route builders should orient from OSM node 2234456923 near Läggesta to node 2908209697 at the Stage 15 junction.

Treat 15:1 as an access connector, not part of the main Stage 15 chain. Offer it only when the selected route includes the Långaedet junction node 2908209697 or when the user explicitly selects Läggesta/15:1.

Access connector from Läggesta station to Långaedet/Stage 15: roughly the first kilometre follows asphalt/road 223 near E20 and then passes under the motorway, with road noise/sun exposure. Several hiker reports say the route does not feel properly off-road until around Ådals kvarn after about 3 km. Walk left where no footway/shoulder exists, use visibility in low light, and do not enter E20 ramps or shoulders.

After Ådals kvarn the route improves: it follows Laketorpsån through a leafy ravine, passes Laketorp meadow/rest context, then uses old path/forest toward a steep descent into Långaedet. Hiker reports consistently treat Ådals kvarn as the mood shift from transport walking to real trail.

Official 15:1 page had no fault reports at research time, but hiker reports note the road/noise/sun-exposed opening, possible muddy/riding-path wear around Ådals/Laketorp, and the descent toward Långaedet can be steep, slippery, icy, or rope-assisted in poor conditions. In winter/thaw, poles or traction can matter more than the short distance suggests.

Långaedet reserve has bark-beetle damaged spruce that can fall, especially in wind. Do not damage living/dead trees; only small loose dry twigs may be collected for a small fire. No designated campsite was verified on the connector; camp only where suitable and permitted under allemansrätten and current fire restrictions.

Do not imply broad camping/fire permission around Långaedet/Marvikarna. Nearby Marvikarna/Krampan continuation has stricter designated-site rules, fishing-card assumptions for inland waters, pet-control rules, and bird-protection closures; keep those as continuation context.

facilities.name: Läggesta trail start
facilities.description: Official connector start at Läggesta station/trail board; OSM info/map node 2917954228 is within a few metres, while route endpoint node 2234456923 is about 23 m away.

facilities.name: Läggesta station
facilities.description: Train/bus access with waiting room/kiosk context, lifts, taxi, three toilets including RWC, and bike parking. Terminal-map bus context includes 303, 305, 306, 543, 642, 646, and 841; check current station opening and departures.

facilities.name: Läggesta station bus stops
facilities.description: Mapped bus-stop cluster at the station entrance, with additional stop positions nearby around 59.248119,17.167025 and 59.248512,17.167754; terminal map lists lines 303, 305, 306, 543, 642, 646, and 841.

facilities.name: Läggesta station parking
facilities.description: Paid municipal station parking, not a free trailhead lot. Strängnäs kommun lists EasyPark zone 18853, 30 SEK/day, 340 SEK/month, and maximum 7 consecutive days. Verify current signs/rates.

facilities.name: Läggesta station toilets
facilities.description: Station toilet context: municipal station information lists three toilets, including accessible WC; exact indoor pin not exposed.

facilities.name: Läggesta station kiosk/snacks
facilities.description: Limited snack/kiosk context near the station; OSM and parcel-service listings confirm the shop but opening hours differ, so verify current hours and do not rely on it as full resupply.

facilities.name: Läggesta bike parking/garage
facilities.description: Covered bike-parking context plus municipal locked bike-garage subscription; useful for train-bike access but verify current availability.

facilities.name: Läggesta Nedre heritage railway
facilities.description: Nearby Östra Södermanlands Järnväg heritage railway context toward Mariefred/Taxinge; seasonal and not core hiking infrastructure.

facilities.name: Sörby bus context
facilities.description: Possible bus/bailout context west of Läggesta near the route corridor; live-check route/frequency before planning around it.

facilities.name: Road/E20 noise section
facilities.description: Early connector follows road 223/asphalt near E20 for about the first kilometre, with traffic noise and sun exposure; hiker reports say quieter off-road trail starts closer to Ådals kvarn after about 3 km.

facilities.name: Road walking safety
facilities.description: Road 223/E20 approach: use the trail underpass, do not enter E20/ramp shoulders, walk on the left where there is no footway or shoulder, and use high visibility in low light.

facilities.name: Ådalskvarns vägskäl bus context
facilities.description: Nearby bus-stop context for the early road section; check live Sörmlandstrafiken.

facilities.name: Ådals kvarn / Laketorpsån bridge
facilities.description: Historic mill/stream point; official text mentions an old mill pond and remains of a silversmithy above the dam. Hiker reports mark this as the mood shift from transport walking to forest/stream path.

facilities.name: Laketorps skola bus context
facilities.description: Possible mid-connector road/bus context near the trail corridor; not a guaranteed frequent stop, so check live Sörmlandstrafiken before relying on it.

facilities.name: Laketorpsån valley
facilities.description: Scenic incised stream valley and deciduous ravine; natural stream context only, not a water refill. Older Sörmlandsleden material warns not to drink from the brook.

facilities.name: Laketorp rest meadow
facilities.description: Official text says the meadow at Laketorp can be used as a rest spot.

facilities.name: Laketorp seasonal mud/riding-path wear
facilities.description: User reports describe the path after Ådals kvarn/Laketorp as a proper but sometimes muddy path also used by riders; treat as a seasonal soft-ground caution.

facilities.name: Stavtorp bus context
facilities.description: Possible road bailout east of the trail corridor, not directly on trail and likely infrequent. Check live planner before relying on it.

facilities.name: Old pack trail / steep descent
facilities.description: Route becomes more forested and descends steeply toward Långaedet; hiker reports mention rope/support usefulness and icy/slippery conditions in winter.

facilities.name: Långaedet / Stage 15 junction
facilities.description: Exact OSM junction node 2908209697 where 15:1 joins main Stage 15, with route choices toward Skottvång or Fredriksberg/Klämmingen. Use this node as the route-builder gate for showing 15:1.

facilities.name: Långaedet information board
facilities.description: Information/map context at the stage-15 junction area.

facilities.name: Långaedet picnic site
facilities.description: Picnic/rest context just west of the connector end.

facilities.name: Långaedet dry toilet
facilities.description: OSM-listed dry toilet near the endpoint/main-route area; not confirmed by the official 15:1 page, so verify condition in the field.

facilities.name: Långaedet fireplace/picnic
facilities.description: Prepared fireplace/picnic context near Långaedet, likely continuation/reserve context rather than core 15:1; use only if current fire conditions allow.

facilities.name: Långaedet viewpoint
facilities.description: Viewpoint/rest context by the Långaedet/Marviken fault landscape; a second nearby viewpoint is mapped to the northwest.

facilities.name: Nearby stage 15 spring
facilities.description: Natural spring a short distance onto stage 15 toward stage 14; treat/filter and do not count as water on the connector itself.

facilities.name: Nearby Bronze Age cairn
facilities.description: Nearby Stage 15 cultural-history context by Långaedet/Marviken narrows; useful if continuing from the connector.

facilities.name: Nearby Mellan-Marviken shelter
facilities.description: Continuation facility south on adjoining stage 15/15:2, not on the 15:1 connector: two shelters, toilet, fireplace/grill, tent context, bathing, and unknown-quality water.

facilities.name: Nearby Mellan-Marviken dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet at/near Mellan-Marviken shelter area, within the useful planning buffer but not on the 15:1 connector itself.

facilities.name: Nearby Mellan-Marviken fireplace
facilities.description: Grill/fireplace context at the Mellan-Marviken shelters, confirmed by shelter/fireplace map sources. Use only if reserve rules and current fire conditions allow.

facilities.name: South Mellan-Marviken picnic/firepit
facilities.description: Nearby OSM picnic/firepit south of the main shelter cluster; off the 15:1 connector and should be treated as continuation context.

facilities.name: Långaedet reserve warning
facilities.description: Bark-beetle affected spruce may fall. Do not damage living/dead wood; only small loose dry twigs may be collected for a small fire. Check current fire bans and posted reserve boards.

facilities.name: Marvikarna/Krampan continuation rules
facilities.description: Continuation south of the 15:1 junction has stricter rules: Marvikarna prohibits camping and fires, Krampan allows fires only at designated places and tenting only in marked areas for up to two nights, dogs/pets leashed or caged, bird sanctuary closure applies 1 Feb-15 Aug, and fishing requires a local permit.

facilities.name: Klövberget/Falkberget continuation closure
facilities.description: Nearby continuation cliffs in the Marvikarna/Krampan reserve are closed to entry from 1 February to 15 August every year for bird protection.

facilities.name: Marvikarna water and ice safety
facilities.description: The Marvikarna/Långaedet lake system is steep and used for paddling, bathing, and winter skating. Use life jacket on water and follow Swedish ice-safety practice with knowledge, equipment, and company on natural ice.

facilities.name: Stage 15:2 Millsjön continuation warning
facilities.description: If continuing via 15:2, official 2025-06-02 warning reports fallen trees along the Millsjön west-side part; passable but awkward, and biotope protection limits clearing.
